comparisons.peer_summary: Restructuring and other charges recognized in operating expenses were $1,533 million in fiscal year 2024 and $244 million in fiscal year 2023. The 2024 charges primarily consisted of employee termination costs related to cost reduction activities associated with the VMware Merger, while the 2023 charges were primarily non-recurring charges related to IP litigation.
comparisons.comparison: Both Intel and Broadcom report specific restructuring and other charges in 2024, but the composition and magnitude differ significantly. Intel recorded $294 million for streamline actions and $780 million for litigation, alongside $3.1 billion in non-cash impairments. In contrast, Broadcom reported higher total restructuring and other charges of $1,533 million, which were primarily driven by employee termination costs related to the VMware Merger, whereas Intel's litigation charge was a distinct legal event.

sentences.text: Charges relating to other actions taken to streamline operations and to reduce costs were $294 million in 2024.
Litigation charges and other includes a charge of $780 million that we recorded in 2024 arising out of the R2 litigation.
In addition, we incurred non-cash impairments relating to goodwill and acquired intangible assets of $3.1 billion in 2024.
Restructuring and other charges recognized in operating expenses were $1,533 million and $244 million in fiscal years 2024 and 2023, respectively.
The fiscal year 2024 charges primarily included employee termination costs from cost reduction activities related to the VMware Merger.
